_source: CurriculumWebsite/docs/product/05-pricing-and-funnel.md §A for the tiers, the annual rule, the pilot and the implementation package; 02-auth-security-licensing.md §C for the soft caps and the one-location licence. Every figure is quoted from those files. The only derived numbers are the effective monthly prices, which are the annual price over twelve; the cards print those in the yearly billing state and the pilot's is the second half of its credit sentence. `items` invents nothing: each array is the band's own `adds` sentence itemised, clause for clause, so the card list and the short prose carry the same claims.

ledger: Pass a seat or student limit and we tell you, and stop new additions — we never lock a coach out of a lesson mid-term. One academy per licence; branches are the Scale tier.
Not built yet: print packs, the owner dashboard, parent reports, your academy’s name on the player, exports, SSO and localization. A pilot tells you exactly what is live on the day you start.
Optional setup is $299, once: we map your existing material onto the curriculum and run a one-hour workshop. Scale includes the workshop.
Most of this market quotes on request. These are the prices; only Enterprise is quoted.
